Food

What comes to the table

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Meze

Salad and dips first, then one round after another: halloumi, mushrooms, sausage, souvlaki, sheftalia and more.

Kleftiko

Lamb kleftiko, named in nine reviews. Guests call it tender, divine and the best they have had.

Vegetarian meze

Five reviews praise the vegetarian and vegan options, one calls them the best they have seen in a tavern.

Celebrations

Guests write about christenings, birthdays and a staff dinner held at the tavern.

A tavern in Agios Tychon

Ta Tria Alonia, the three threshing floors, is on Georgiou Griva Digeni in the village of Agios Tychon, in the Limassol district. Guests write about an old house with a courtyard, plates that keep coming until nobody can eat more, and a meze that also comes vegetarian.

What guests say

Three of 299 Google reviews, 248 of them with five stars.
